description: List quotes (Offerten) from AbaNinja. Filters: status ('offen' | 'angenommen' | 'abgelehnt' | 'abgelaufen' | 'alle'), from/to (quote date, YYYY-MM-DD), customer (name or customer number, substring), limit. Returns quote number, date, valid-until, customer, amount, currency and status. Read-only. 'offen' means still awaiting a decision AND not past its valid-until date — an expired quote is pipeline that no longer exists, so it is not counted as open; ask for 'abgelaufen' to see those.

customer.description: Substring of customer name or customer number.

name: list_abaninja_quotes
